moaSummary.value: Inhibits bacterial protein synthesis on the ocular surface — educational framing for red-eye counselling only; confirm against labelled product. Never invent a dose or duration.
Increases uveoscleral outflow to lower IOP — iris darkening / lash growth counselling hooks; regimens stay clinician-directed.
Reduces aqueous humour production via ocular beta blockade — systemic absorption and asthma/bradycardia cautions are the teaching hooks.

lessons.title: When red eye is not simple
lessons.body: Pain, photophobia, or vision change needs clinician review. Educational counselling: drop technique and bottle hygiene — Materia does not publish drop schedules here.

lessons.title: Eye-drop beta-blockers are still beta-blockers
lessons.body: Timolol–atenolol teaching is about escalating additive bradycardia/hypotension risk to the clinician, not inventing a switch. Confirm against current SA guidance and the labelled products.

quiz.prompt: A patient on atenolol starts Timoptol. Best educational frame?
choices: Ignore it — eye drops stay in the eye
Flag additive systemic beta-blockade and escalate clinically — do not invent a dose
Stop all glaucoma therapy without advice
quiz.teachFromMiss: Interaction counselling means escalate — Materia never invents ophthalmic or systemic beta-blocker dose changes.
